scope: Independent seven-bay East Wing candidate; facade openings and roof-end shape are explicit modeling assumptions

documented.relative_position: East wing beside the east side of the approach path in front of Dacheng Hall; the West Wing occupies the west side
documented.period: Historical museum description following the 1997 repair; not verified as the 2026 condition

historical_evidence_excluded_from_modern.nine_bays_each: Applies only to the period before the Qing Shunzhi era
historical_evidence_excluded_from_modern.front_corridor: Documented only for the period before the Qing Shunzhi era; no modern front corridor or colonnade is inferred

interpretations.status: Final candidate parameters, still requiring stronger photographic or survey evidence
interpretations.measurement_endpoints: The source leaves wall, column, eave and base limits unspecified. The model assigns the documented length and width to the base envelope.
interpretations.roof_type: Assumed single-ridge, simple two-slope gable roof. The museum text does not specify a roof type, and the contextual aerial does not establish the roof ends.
interpretations.facade_partition: Seven equal divisions are a modeling estimate. Only the total count of seven bays is documented; actual bay widths and structural positions are unknown.

openings.status: Entire opening scheme is an estimate. The text does not document a central entrance, window count, opening dimensions, leaf layout or lattice pattern.

interpretations.colors: Original grey roof, light wall and red-brown timber approximations. Detailed colours and material values are unverified; no photograph-derived PBR.
interpretations.rear_and_sides: Plain closure walls and assumed roof-end infills; rear openings and details remain unknown
interpretations.front: Local -Y facade; actual entrance direction unverified
interpretations.actual_export_envelope: See audit geometry.json; full roof cap and tile ends extend beyond main roof sheets; not documentary measurement limits

area_arithmetic_check.limit: Numerical consistency only; it does not prove that the source dimensions refer to base, wall, column or eave limits

omitted: Interior shrines, spirit tablets, statues and exhibition displays
Unsupported inscriptions, brackets and exact carved decoration
identity_limits: East Wing identity and relative position come from museum text, with coarse aerial context. The candidate is not an individually verified photographic reconstruction or an acceptance of the actual opening and roof-end layout.
